insight: A Y Combinator W24 startup founded by Cornell alumni Hayden Housen and Ryan Tremblay.
name: Sonauto
tagline: AI music generator that creates full songs with vocals and instrumentals.
description: Sonauto generates complete, radio-quality songs — vocals and instrumentals — from a text prompt, your own lyrics, or a hummed melody. It is powered by Melodia, the company's in-house music foundation model, and ships a developer API alongside the web app. A free tier is available with paid credit plans for higher volume and commercial use.

modelSupport.notes: Built on Sonauto's own Melodia music foundation model.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from audio to the new dedicated music-generation category.

edge: Uses latent diffusion in continuous space, not an audio-token LM like most rivals — pitched as fast, steerable full songs, plus an API.
